title: festuca glauca var. pannonica
intro: Festuca glauca var. pannonica, commonly known as Hungarian blue fescue, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It is native to Europe and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. Festuca glauca var. pannonica contains bioactive constituents such as phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
